title: Parent field and Business Service relationship of an offering do not match
cardHint: The Parent field of a Service Offering and its Business Service relationship do not name the same service. SACM fixes it.
cardText: The Parent field of a Service Offering and its Business Service relationship must name the same, single Business Service. SACM fixes it, nobody is asked: use the fix list. When the Parent field names a service and no relationship exists, add the relationship to that service.
